title: Compose conflict-aware DIAT matter assessments without identity mutation
summary: Combine eligible acoustic, behavior, procedural and optional semantic evidence into an experimental matter assessment that preserves disagreement and proposes a useful next check. Reuse Matter's judgment/assessment contract and DIAT's frozen candidate boundary; no second resolver or automatic identity write path is introduced.
in_scope: Experimental assessment export and stale-hint invalidation
out_of_scope: Multiplying or adding relevance/compatibility into acoustic identity probability
Semantic candidate creation outside the frozen pool
Enrollment, confirmation or production identity assignment
Automatic user questions for every uncertain segment
implementation: Map copied evidence records to neutral claims/judgments and bind exact package/source/profile/question/qualification versions and availability cutoffs.

Ask focused semantic questions only about ambiguous evidence relationships; compose validated outcomes in code and retain raw acoustic cosine, behavior comparisons, semantic relevance and procedural compatibility separately.
Produce anonymous consistency or fixed-candidate experimental decisions, unknown/manual_review/failure outcomes, supporting/counterevidence and a named next permissible check.

Track the unresolved concern across observations using a stable matter reference independent of profile/model/recording revisions; distinguish a changed source invalidating an old hint from verified resolution.

Export a bounded experimental assessment and attention delta through the existing neutral contracts; recheck source/profile/revocation freshness before displaying a private hint and record emission separately from action.

acceptance.criterion: An out-of-pool candidate or unqualified semantic result cannot become a resolved experimental identity.
acceptance.verification: Run typed output and stale/failed qualification controls through the production experiment adapter.

acceptance.criterion: Acoustic/procedural disagreement stays visible and can yield unknown rather than forced consistency.
acceptance.verification: Use a recognized-chair cue conflicting with the acoustic pool and inspect the named conflict and permitted next check.

acceptance.criterion: Source/profile changes invalidate dependent private hints without rewriting earlier assessments.
acceptance.verification: Change an input digest or revoke a reference between selection and emission; verify withheld reason and historical receipt preservation.

acceptance.criterion: The integration performs zero enrollment, confirmation or core-service mutation.
acceptance.verification: Instrument clients/write methods and compare state before/after a representative synthetic and authorized private run.

tests: High semantic relevance with absent acoustic candidate
Strong procedural cue with ambiguous/mixed voice
Provider failed versus no relevant evidence
Stale reference profile before private hint emission
Same concern reworded after another turn
Resolved experimental output attempts a production enrollment call
risks: A new fusion module could quietly duplicate or bypass the production resolver.
A summary can erase disagreement unless typed evidence dimensions and outcomes are retained.

reuse.application: Reuse fixed candidates, typed decisions, private package binding and no identity-write behavior.

reuse.source: MAT-015/MAT-016/MAT-031 neutral assessment and qualification contracts
reuse.application: Use one shared semantic contract and dependency mechanism rather than another decision store.

sources: User clarification, 2026-10-08, active Matter build: DIAT owns meeting learning; roughly 315 hours/5–10 recurring people is user-reported; crawler owns jurisdiction knowledge; private exported-data experiments only.
Original repository inputs: matterbrainstormspec; matterjevmesh; jevinmatter (brainstorming, not implementation evidence).
